full_prompt_en: A square street-art image shows a young man sitting with head bowed on a low chair against a white wall burst with vivid paint splashes. The figure occupies the center, knees spread and elbows resting on the thighs. His forearms meet over his hands, forming a compact dark shape below the face. Short dark hair and a lowered head obscure the eyes. The body is rendered mainly in black, white, and gray, with a hooded top, trousers, and sneakers, but bright paint marks appear on the sleeves, pant legs, and shoes. Behind him, clouds of yellow, magenta, cyan, green, and orange spray outward in irregular patches from shoulder level to the floor. Thin drips run vertically down the wall, while sharper starburst marks extend sideways and upward. The low seat is partly visible between the legs, its dark frame splattered with color. Across the floor, pooled and scattered paint gathers around the shoes, making a multicolored ground plane against the otherwise plain white setting. The person's detailed gray shading gives weight to fabric folds and hands, in contrast to the freer graphic motion of the pigment. Light appears broad and frontal, with soft shadows under the chair and feet; the dramatic effect comes primarily from value and color rather than a directional spotlight. The wall's pale texture remains visible through thin paint in some areas, while thicker bursts obscure it. No other people or readable text appear. The overall composition is emotionally compressed but visually explosive, using the still downward figure as the anchor for an outward eruption of saturated color.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形街头艺术图像呈现一名年轻男子低头坐在矮椅上，背后白墙被鲜艳泼漆炸开。人物占据中央，双膝分开，肘部搭在大腿上。前臂在双手附近合拢，脸下形成紧凑深形。深色短发与垂下的头遮住眼睛。身体主要用黑、白、灰绘成，穿连帽上衣、长裤和运动鞋，但袖子、裤腿与鞋上都有明亮颜料痕迹。身后，黄、品红、青蓝、绿和橙色云状颜料从肩高一直向地面不规则地向外喷发。细颜料滴垂直流下墙面，更锐的星爆状痕迹向两侧及上方伸展。低座椅在两腿之间部分可见，深色框架也被泼上颜色。地面上，积聚与散落的颜料围住鞋子，在其他部分朴素白色的场景中形成多彩地面。人物细致灰阶阴影给予衣褶和手重量，与颜料更自由的图形动势形成对比。光似乎宽广而从正面照来，椅下与脚下留柔影；戏剧效果主要来自明度和色彩，而非定向聚光。墙面浅色肌理在薄漆处仍可见，较厚喷发区域则遮住它。没有其他人物或可读文字。整体构图在情绪上收紧，在视觉上爆裂，以静止低垂的人物固定一场向外喷发的饱和色。
style_prompt_en: The street-art treatment opposes carefully shaded grayscale forms to loose, high-chroma paint bursts. Dense dark detail creates a stable central mass, while magenta, cyan, yellow, orange, and green spread outward in sprays, drips, and rough clouds. Pale wall space around the explosion keeps the color legible and makes each trajectory visible. Some pigment is translucent enough to show the substrate; thicker splashes remain opaque and textured. Broad frontal light maintains clear volume on the central shape, with only small contact shadows below. Vertical drips counter fast lateral and radial splatter, giving the composition several kinds of motion. The overall effect is raw and expressive, built from the tension between inward stillness and outward color energy.
style_prompt_zh: 这种街头艺术处理让细致灰阶塑形与松散高彩颜料喷发相对。密集深色细节构成稳定中央体量，品红、青蓝、黄、橙、绿则作为喷点、流滴与粗糙云团向外扩散。爆发周围的浅墙空处使颜色清楚，也让每条轨迹可辨。一些颜料薄到可透出底层载体，较厚泼点则不透明且有肌理。宽广正面光保持中央形状的清楚体积，下方只有少量接触阴影。竖直流滴对照快速横向和放射泼溅，为构图带来多种运动。整体效果粗粝而富表现力，由向内的静止与向外的色彩能量之间的张力构成。
theme_en: A bowed seated figure in grayscale surrounded by vivid paint splashes
theme_zh: 一名低头坐着的灰阶人物被鲜艳泼漆包围
name: Martin Whatson
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
